title: Charred Twitcher

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Charred Twitchers are hostile enemies found in the Ashlands. These guys are always twitching, as their name suggests.
There is an alternate summoned version, with only 50 health, invoked by Warlocks, see Summoned Twitcher.

sections.heading: Scratch
sections.text: Swipes at the player with one of its claws (100 Slash damage). This attack has two variations, each with its own 3-second cooldown: one with the left claw and one with the right. Both variations swing in a 3-meter 115-degree horizontal arc and can be used when within 1.6 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Throw
sections.text: Picks up a stone from the ground and lobs it at the player (75 Pierce damage). The stone travels at a random velocity between 50–60 meters per second, with a spread of 4–20 degrees. It can travel for up to 4 seconds before despawning. This attack can be used every 6 seconds when between 6–40 meters of a player.

Introduction. Charred Twitchers are hostile enemies found in the Ashlands. These guys are always twitching, as their name suggests.
There is an alternate summoned version, with only 50 health, invoked by Warlocks, see Summoned Twitcher.

Drops. Charred Twitchers have no trophy.

Scratch. Swipes at the player with one of its claws (100 Slash damage). This attack has two variations, each with its own 3-second cooldown: one with the left claw and one with the right. Both variations swing in a 3-meter 115-degree horizontal arc and can be used when within 1.6 meters of a player.

Throw. Picks up a stone from the ground and lobs it at the player (75 Pierce damage). The stone travels at a random velocity between 50–60 meters per second, with a spread of 4–20 degrees. It can travel for up to 4 seconds before despawning. This attack can be used every 6 seconds when between 6–40 meters of a player.
